{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text.Lazy (Text)
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy.Encoding as TLE
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import Crypto.MAC.HMAC (hmac, HMAC(..))
import Crypto.Hash (SHA256)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr)

-- | Application configuration
data AppConfig = AppConfig
  { appSigningKey    :: BS.ByteString
  , appEncryptionKey :: BS.ByteString
  , appEnvironment   :: String
  , appPort          :: Int
  }

-- | Derive a key from the master secret for a specific purpose
deriveKey :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
deriveKey master purpose =
  let h = hmac master purpose :: HMAC SHA256
  in BS.take 32 (convert h)

-- | Initialize configuration from environment
initConfig :: IO AppConfig
initConfig = do
  env <- fromMaybe "development" <$> lookupEnv "APP_ENV"
  mMaster <- lookupEnv "MASTER_SECRET"
  masterSecret <- case mMaster of
    Just s  -> return s
    Nothing ->
      if env == "development"
        then return "change-me-in-production"
        else do
          hPutStrLn stderr "FATAL: MASTER_SECRET must be set in non-development environments."
          exitFailure
  let master = encodeUtf8Strict masterSecret
  -- Always derive separate keys regardless of environment
  -- Key separation is a fundamental security property
  let sigKey = deriveKey master "signing"
  let encKey = deriveKey master "encryption"
  port <- maybe 3000 read <$> lookupEnv "PORT"
  return AppConfig
    { appSigningKey    = sigKey
    , appEncryptionKey = encKey
    , appEnvironment   = env
    , appPort          = port
    }

encodeUtf8Strict :: String -> BS.ByteString
encodeUtf8Strict = BS.pack . map (fromIntegral . fromEnum)

-- | Sign a message
signMessage :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
signMessage key msg =
  let h = hmac key msg :: HMAC SHA256
  in convert h

-- | Constant-time equality check to avoid timing side-channels
constEq :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
constEq = BA.constEq

-- | Create a signed token
createToken :: AppConfig -> BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
createToken cfg payload = do
  ts <- show . round <$> getPOSIXTime
  let tsBytes = encodeUtf8Strict ts
  let content = payload <> "|" <> tsBytes
  let sig = signMessage (appSigningKey cfg) content
  return $ B64.encode (content <> "." <> sig)

-- | Verify a signed token
verifyToken :: AppConfig -> BS.ByteString -> Maybe BS.ByteString
verifyToken cfg token =
  case B64.decode token of
    Left _ -> Nothing
    Right decoded ->
      let parts = BS.breakSubstring "." decoded
      in case parts of
        (content, rest)
          | BS.length rest > 1 ->
            let sig = BS.drop 1 rest
                expected = signMessage (appSigningKey cfg) content
            in if constEq sig expected
               then Just content
               else Nothing
          | otherwise -> Nothing

-- | XOR-based encryption using the encryption key
xorEncrypt :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
xorEncrypt key plaintext =
  let keyStream = BS.concat $ replicate (1 + BS.length plaintext `div` BS.length key) key
  in BS.pack $ BS.zipWith xor plaintext keyStream
  where xor a b = a `Prelude.xor` b

-- | Encrypt sensitive data
encryptData :: AppConfig -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encryptData cfg = xorEncrypt (appEncryptionKey cfg)

-- | Decrypt sensitive data
decryptData :: AppConfig -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
decryptData cfg = xorEncrypt (appEncryptionKey cfg)

-- | Main application
main :: IO Main.main
main = do
  cfg <- initConfig
  sessionsRef <- newIORef ([] :: [(BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString)])
  
  scotty (appPort cfg) $ do
    get "/health" $ do
      text "ok"
    
    post "/login" $ do
      username <- param "username"
      let userData = encodeUtf8Strict (TL.unpack username)
      -- Encrypt user data and create signed session token
      let encrypted = encryptData cfg userData
      token <- liftIO $ createToken cfg encrypted
      liftIO $ modifyIORef sessionsRef ((token, encrypted) :)
      text $ TL.pack $ show $ B64.encode token
    
    get "/session" $ do
      tokenParam <- param "token"
      let tokenBS = encodeUtf8Strict (TL.unpack tokenParam)
      case B64.decode tokenBS of
        Left _ -> text "invalid token encoding"
        Right rawToken ->
          case verifyToken cfg rawToken of
            Nothing -> text "invalid signature"
            Just content -> do
              let decrypted = decryptData cfg content
              text $ TL.pack $ show decrypted
    
    get "/debug/keys" $ do
      if appEnvironment cfg == "development"
        then text $ TL.pack $ "signing == encryption: " ++ show (appSigningKey cfg == appEncryptionKey cfg)
        else text "not available"
